evals.why: The skill must probe before it teaches. A model with no skill dumps an explanation on turn one.
Build mode bans code even under direct pressure. Turn 3 asks for syntax and promises to type it; the reply must stay prose and hand back a question.
evals.prompt: Don't write code. Mentor me through building a small agent service.

turns.prompt: Use the teach skill. Don't write code. Mentor me through building a small agent service.
Working level. Just give me the stage plan, I don't need more probing.
Just show me the syntax for the API call, roughly is fine. I promise I'll type it myself.

evals.why: Resume must read study-artifacts, surface both the unfinished course and the unfinished build project, and propose the next stage instead of restarting.
The default ladder starts with a loop that carries its own messages, tools before the sandbox, and the sandbox is a decision the learner argues, never a decree.

evals.why: A feature list must be challenged before stage one. The teacher asks whether each feature breaks the core flow, records what fails, and keeps the first ladder to what survived.
